4. Fetch the FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR from V_CRR_CALENDAR_HORIZON_CORE  corresponding to SUPPLIER_CONFIRMATION_DELIVERY_DTM & Prject in the FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR_Supplier_Confirmation.

To Fetch  GOODS_RECEIVED_DT :-. Join IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_BRD_PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_HEADER_LINE_ROOT and IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM_BASE.T_BRD_PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_GOODS_RECEIPT_INVOICE_RECEIPT_ROOT based on  PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_NBR & PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_LINE_NBR, Fetch Latest date i.e.  GOODS_RECEIVED_DT from the GOODS_RECEIPT_INVOICE_RECEIPT_ROOT & Project in GOODS_RECEIVED_DT.
6. Derive the CONFIRMED_PO_IND column:-   
Here we will Derive - UNCONFIRMED,      Full confirmation,            Partial confirmation- All QTY,                    Partial confirmation- Partial QTY,                   
(i) Unconfirmed- Not confirmed by Supplier.
 Where  SUPPLIER_CONFIRMED_DELIVERY_DT = is  BLANK & SUPPLIER_CONFIRMATION_CATEGORY_CODE='' BLANK then mark  UNCONFIRMED. 
(ii) Full confirmation- All QTYs delivery will be confirmed at once on a date. 
  When for Particular PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_NBR & PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_LINE_NBR  check SUPPLIER_CONFIRMED_DELIVERY_DT  =  Not Null or Not Blank &   SUPPLIER_CONFIRMED_QTY =  SCHEDULE_LINE_DELIVERY_QTY  , Then Project the FULL CONFIRMATION.
(iii) Partial confirmation, All QTY: All QTYs delivered across multiple dates
 When for Particular PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_NBR & PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_LINE_NBR  , Aggregate Sum of SUPPLIER_CONFIRMED_QTY =   Aggregate Sum of SCHEDULE_LINE_DELIVERY_QTY then project the PARTIAL CONFIRMATION- ALL QTY.

(iv) Partial confirmation, Partial QTY: Partial QTYs confirmed when compared to requested QTY across multiple dates
When for Particular PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_NBR &PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_LINE_NBR ,  Aggregate Sum of SUPPLIER_CONFIRMED_QTY < Aggregate Sum of SCHEDULE_LINE_DELIVERY_QTY  then project the PARTIAL CONFIRMATION- PARTIAL QTY.
6. -For  PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_NBR and PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_LINE_NBR&   PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_SCHEDULE_LINE_NBR , Drive EXCESS_DELIVERY_QTY BY Performing SCHEDULE_LINE_DELIVERY_QTY - GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY, Project values only if The received Qty is greater than Schedule line delivery Qty. 
Eg. If recived qty is 120 agaisnt delivert qty of 100 then the rersulut is 100-120= -20, instead of -20 project 20 which is non negative value.
7. Calculate OPEN_PO_QTY, OPEN_PO_Date & PO_STATUS
For PO where CONFIRMED_PO_IND is UNCONFIRMED.
OPEN_PO_QTY  =:-For  PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_NBR and PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_LINE_NBR we have  Aggregate SCHEDULE_LINE_DELIVERY_QTY and Aggregate GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY from PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_SCHEDULE_LINE table.
 IF aggregate GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY >  aggregate SCHEDULE_LINE_DELIVERY_QTY THEN project 0 (or we can say that if EXCESS_DELIVERY_QTY is negative then project 0 instead of negative value) ELSE  project actual qty by subtraction (SCHEDULE_LINE_DELIVERY_QTY - GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY ) >0 
OPEN_PO_Date=  is same as  REQUESTED_DELIVERY_DTM
PO_STATUS = if OPEN_PO_QTY = 0 & DELIVERY_COMPLETE_IND= Y then COMPLETE else OPEN
Calculate OPEN_PO_QTY, OPEN_PO_Date & PO_STATUS
For PO where CONFIRMED_PO_IND is Full confirmation
OPEN_PO_QTY  =:-For  PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_NBR and PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_LINE_NBR we have   SUPPLIER_CONFIRMED_QTY from supplier CONFIRMATION table  and GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY from schedule line table . &
 calculate aggregate SUPPLIER_CONFIRMED_QTY – aggregate RECEIVED_QTY.
FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR_Supplier_Confirmation =  FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR_Purchase_Doc
OPEN_PO_Date=  SUPPLIER_CONFIRMED_DELIVERY_DT+  GOODS_RECEIPT_PROCESS_TIME_DAY_CNT
PO_STATUS = if OPEN_PO_QTY = 0 & DELIVERY_COMPLETE_IND= Y then COMPLETE else OPEN
Calculate OPEN_PO_QTY, OPEN_PO_Date & PO_STATUS
For PO where CONFIRMED_PO_IND is  Partial confirmation- All QTY
OPEN_PO_QTY  =:-For  PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_NBR and  PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_LINE_NBR & PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_SCHEDULE_LINE_NBR, we have GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY from Schedule line table & For  PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_NBR and  PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_LINE_NBR level we have  SUPPLIER_CONFIRMED_QTY from supplier CONFIRMATION table. 
Check SUPPLIER_CONFIRMED_QTY >=PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_LINE_QTY 
calculate OPEN_PO QTY = SUPPLIER_CONFIRMED_QTY minus  Aggregate RECEIVED_QTY.  
OPEN_PO_Date=  SUPPLIER_CONFIRMED_DELIVERY_DT +  GOODS_RECEIPT_PROCESS_TIME_DAY_CNT
PO_STATUS = if OPEN_PO_QTY = 0 & DELIVERY_COMPLETE_IND= Y then COMPLETE else OPEN

Aggregated logic of Received qty of fifo= For  PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_NBR and  PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_LINE_NBR & PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_SCHEDULE_LINE_NBR, we have GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY from Schedule line table & For  PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_NBR and  PURCHASE_DOCUMENT_LINE_NBR level we have  SUPPLIER_CONFIRMED_QTY from supplier CONFIRMATION table. We dont have confirmation qty on Schedule line level, we have confirmation qty only on the Purchase document line number only.
But we have received qty at schedule line number thats why the received qty is aggregated.

OPEN_PO_Date=  SUPPLIER_CONFIRMED_DELIVERY_DT+  GOODS_RECEIPT_PROCESS_TIME_DAY_CNT
